900.3.10(466).explanation: On the lands covered by Exception RD 466, the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, side yards must be at least 1.2 m (4.5 m beside a street), the required parking space must be inside the residential building, an attached or detached garage must be at least 0.3 m from a side lot line that does not abut a street, and exception 900.3.10(1462) also applies.

900.3.10(368).explanation: On the lands covered by Exception RD 368, the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, side yards must be at least 1.2 m (3.6 m beside a street), a garage must be at least 0.3 m from a side lot line that does not abut a street, and a lot front line on Bellamy, Brimley, McCowan, Midland or Danforth must be set back 22.0 m from the original street centreline.

900.3.10(421).explanation: On the lands covered by Exception RD 421, the minimum lot frontage and lot area are those that existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, side yards must be at least 1.2 m (5.7 m beside a street), and a lot front line on Bellamy, Scarborough Golf Club, Orton Park or McCowan must be set back 22.0 m from the original street centreline.
